messages:
Nora: Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands  need a 2-line internal elevator pitch that differentiates us vs DIY cloud endpoints and vs raw runtimes.
Kate (CEO): 2-line: "Redwood removes inference ops risk so product teams ship reliably: predictable latency, transparent unit economics, and built-in migration paths." "You avoid months of infra work and get inference-specific primitives (autoscale, KV caching, rollouts) out of the box."
Sam: Can PMs get a prioritization heuristic tied to the mission? Something ICs can use in PRDs.
Ivy: Proposed heuristic: Score features on (1) predictability impact, (2) cost impact, (3) cross-deploy portability. Prioritize items scoring >=2.
Dev: Ops note: if a Hosted-first feature is unavoidable, require an explicit migration plan and a migration owner in the PRD. Also add a short infra checklist: model pins, config export, warm-cache steps.
Nora: Sales wants a short rebuttal to "we can just run endpoints in our cloud". One-liner?
Kate (CEO): "You can build endpoints, but you still need inference-specific building blocks and operational playbooks. We give those with cost transparency and migration support, saving engineering cycles."
Sam: Legal on using numbers in pitch decks — can we say X% lower cost?
legal-bot: Don’t publish quantitative claims without a signed customer case study or GTM ops signoff. Use qualitative language and approved vignettes.
Nora: Ok. Action items: Sam to draft the 2-line elevator pitch + 3 rebuttals; Ivy to add the prioritization heuristic to the PRD template; Dev to add the infra migration checklist to the runbook.
ops-bot: Recording + slides uploaded https://redwood.internal/all-hands/2801234567 :memo:
Nora: thanks all, posting summary in #product-playbooks shortly :thumbsup:
